name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction

instructions.description: Lie on your side with the bottom leg bent for support and the top leg straight.
Stack the hips and keep the top foot in line with the body.
Lift the top leg upward to a comfortable height without rolling the pelvis backward.
Lower the leg slowly and repeat before changing sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use controlled lifts that target the side hip musculature.

variations.variationDescription: Progresses the side-hip pattern using a longer lever and more abduction range.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Bend the knees to shorten the lever and reduce difficulty.

commentsNotes: Keep the toes facing forward or slightly down.
Do not swing the leg upward.
